results.corrected_extracted: Up to 75% of rave attenders used several substances, with an average of five drugs at the last rave attended (ref. 12, a cluster analysis of underground rave attenders); polysubstance use in club and dance venues is described as widespread. A small sedative-and-alcohol class had last-year prevalence of 1.3% among young Australian adults (ref. 22).
